title: Workshop: build a responsive landing page
summary: Build a landing page mobile first, adding queries for width, hover, dark mode, reduced motion and print.
intro: a landing page with a header, a hero, four route cards and a footer. The HTML is already written (see the html tab). You write the small-screen layout first, then add media queries one at a time. The checks cover the base styles. The media rules themselves can't be checked automatically, so use the Phone, Tablet and Full width buttons to see each one work.
